title: Using AI tools to teach old apps new tricks | BRK220

segments.text: Jeff Fritz: Hey.
Good morning, everyone.
It's so good to see you here live
at Microsoft Build in San Francisco.
And for those of you that are out there watching at home
around the world, welcome in.
It's so good to have you joining us.
And of course, those of you that are watching the recording,
thank you so much for tuning in as well.
My name is Jeff Fritz, and I'm a Principal Program Manager
on the GitHub Copilot Modernization team.
And in today's session, I'm going to be joined
by my colleagues, Nish and Hazem, and we're going to look
at how AI is changing modernization itself.
Not just how you write code,
but also how you eliminate the day-to-day friction
that slows your teams down.
Those upgrades, those migrations, and worst of all,
the tech debt backlogs.

and the system that you're going to see here in my systems,
and it's been a magnificent experience that I can't wait
for you to learn more about.
Now, for you enterprise developers out there,
this is a game changer in how you scale your work
without losing customization or control.
Let's dive into it.
So look, modernization isn't new.
But now with AI in the picture, it's more urgent than ever.
Forrester's Q1 2026 survey says that 94%
of IT leaders rank app modernization
as a top investment for the next six to 12 months.

There's some serious furto behind the way
that these teams keep legacy systems alive.

every day.
Over a third of modernization projects stall,
because monoliths are just that complex.
Resources are tight, and security concerns pile up.

that technical debt doesn't just sit there.
It grows. It grows kind of like a fungus, and eats into the time
that you'd be spending on the AI-ready work
that your organizations are asking you to prioritize.

It is what it unlocks --
the innovation, the new capabilities.
But the toil of actually getting there, that's the blocker.
So that's why developers, architects,
and planners are turning to agents,
to cut through the manual work, manage the complexity,
and keep things secure along the way.
Now, when we're building agents for modernization,
we're not just thinking about one team or one role.
We're targeting the pain points across your entire organization
that are going to slow you down.
Customers keep telling us the same three things:
They need scale, they need customization,
and they need governance.
And the Forrester data backs this up with 87% or more
of organizations agreeing that they need all three.
So when we think about scaling, you're not going to work
on just one app at a time in your code editor.
That's not going to get you there.
You need your entire modernization lifecycle

version upgrades, framework changes,
all of it executing together.
And we need customization in this.
We know that every app is different,
and you didn't write the same source code
for every application.
We've seen some of your code.
Agents can be set up and provisioned to assess
and transform code based on each application's specific needs
and objectives.
And of course, governance.
All of this transformation has to happen safely.
And that means human in the loop review.
But also, there's policies that we can implement that help
to engage approval and band patterns.
Compliance rules can be baked in with monitoring
and audit trails the whole way through our process.
We're investing in all three areas
so agents can help you modernize faster
and you get more time back to actually innovate.
Building great agents matters.
But building them natively where you already work
across workloads that you actually have, that's going
to give you an unmatched experience,
a connected platform, and trust.
You're going to see these tenets show up throughout the product.
First, we want to allow you to work where you work.
76% of developers live in Visual Studio code, Visual Studio,
IntelliJ, the Command Line, and GitHub.
So instead of asking you to go learn another application
or go figure out another console app,
we're going to bring the agents to you.
Second, we want to build with any workload.
We're already serving over 16 million .NET
and Java developers, and we're the only vendor taking a truly
holistic estate-level approach.

and infrastructure together.

to solve your modernization issues.

SQL Server, even mainframes.

Modernization should be continuous,
intelligent, and collaborative.

and GitHub Copilot together form the first end-to-end agentic
modernization solution, unifying IT
and developer workflows in one system.

troubleshoot optimize.
Modernization isn't a one-time project anymore.
It's a continuous loop.
And the proof is in the numbers.
We're seeing 70% reductions in modernization time,
over 50% reductions in effort to eliminate technical debt.

A few apps at a time, that's it.
So think of it this way.
Our agents are purpose-built for every stage
of the continuous modernization lifecycle.
The left side, modernization.
The right side, operations.

observability, incident response,
